title: The studio behind Pokémon struggles to find its voice in Beast of Reincarnation
summary: Game Freak ventures beyond its Pokémon franchise with Beast of Reincarnation, an action game intended to showcase the studio's creative potential. However, the game lacks the innovative ideas needed to stand out in the crowded action genre. The project represents an ambitious attempt to break from the pocket monster series but ultimately falls short in execution.
content:
You have to imagine that the team at Game Freak is bursting with ideas. The studio puts out new mainline Pokémon adventures with a machinelike precision. But every so often it launches a curious experiment, whether it's an action title about a militarized elephant or turning horse races into a card game, showing that it's capable of more than the latest generation of pocket monsters. That's part of what makes the idea of Beast of Reincarnation so enticing. zh.title: 开发精灵宝可梦的工作室在《转生之兽》中难以找到自己的声音
zh.summary: Game Freak通过《转生之兽》这款动作游戏进军精灵宝可梦系列之外，意图展示该工作室的创意潜力。然而，这款游戏缺乏在拥挤的动作游戏类型中脱颖而出所需的创新理念。该项目代表了一次雄心勃勃的尝试，试图打破口袋妖怪系列的束缚，但在执行中最终功亏一篑。
